title: Presets
objective: Named, reusable settings sets applied as one history entry through a presets module, kept in the catalog and importable from Lightroom Classic XMP and .lrtemplate presets with an explicit per-setting report, with full UI/API parity.
context_summary: The design fixes the contract: settings sets over field-patch actions, a host composite plan, the lightwell.presets module with apply-preset, the string and settings parameter kinds and the presets control, a catalog format 5 library behind preset.* methods, and an importer whose Lightroom mappings are value transfers that never clamp. The owner asked for implementation on recorded defaults without blocking.

tasks.description: Add composite plans, the string and settings parameter kinds, the presets control and the lightwell.presets module with apply-preset.
extra_context: The host runs each Compose step through the registry against the intermediate stack and commits once; a nested composite, a non-patch, unknown or unavailable action is refused and nothing is written.
draft_recipe and apply_action share one plan-application helper.

context_links.label: Presets design
context_links.relevance: Composite actions, the module and the descriptor additions.

context_links.label: Modules and API
context_links.relevance: Module trait, field patches, host dispatch and registry validation.

context_links.label: UI components
context_links.relevance: The string parameter kind's specified bounds.

acceptance_criteria: edit.apply-preset over Basic, Presence, mixer and vignette fields commits exactly one entry labelled Preset: <name> whose stack equals the same fields sent through the individual edit.set-* actions; untouched fields keep their values.
A preset that changes nothing is a no-op with no entry; undo returns to the stack from before the preset.
Registry validation rejects a presets control on an action without the required parameters and a second presets control; generic checks reject malformed string and settings values.
schema.list and module.list describe apply-preset with its kinds; the draft effective recipe of apply-preset equals its commit.

steps: Unit-test the new kinds and control validation in the descriptor and registry.
Integration-test composite commits, no-ops, refusals and undo against JPEG fixtures in lightwell-core.
expected_results: All new and existing core tests pass.

tasks.description: Build the preset importer: format detection, the Lightwell preset document, Lightroom XMP, .lrtemplate, the mapping table and the report.
extra_context: Pure functions over text and the module registry: no catalog, no file access, no rendering.
Mapped values are value transfers; out-of-range values are refused, never clamped.

context_links.label: Presets design
context_links.relevance: Detection, parsing rules, mapping table and report categories.

context_links.label: Lightroom preset formats
context_links.relevance: XMP and .lrtemplate structure, value encoding, field inventory, process versions and panel switches.

context_links.label: Slider range audit
context_links.relevance: Importer constraints and the RAW white-balance mismatch.

acceptance_criteria: Checked-in fixture presets (XMP with attributes and child elements, another namespace prefix, a profile, an earlier process version, an out-of-range value, a sidecar, a .lrtemplate with ZSTR and nested tables, a Lightwell document) each produce the exact asserted settings and report.
Every mapped target is a registered presettable parameter whose hard range covers the claimed Lightroom range, checked by a test.
Malformed, oversized or over-deep input fails with a structured error and no panic; a 1 MiB document parses within the recorded bound.

steps: Run the importer tests over the fixture presets and malformed inputs.
Time the worst-case parse in release mode on the M4.
expected_results: Exact settings and reports for every fixture; bounded errors for malformed input.

tasks.description: Store the preset library in catalog format 5 and expose preset.list, read, create, capture, update, delete, export, inspect and import.
extra_context: Library methods take actor, not a mutation envelope; (group, name) is unique ignoring case; at most 1,000 presets.
Capture reads payloads only through module values and declared defaults.

context_links.label: Presets design
context_links.relevance: Library schema, record, methods and capture.

context_links.label: Architecture
context_links.relevance: Catalog persistence and the agent contract.

acceptance_criteria: A format 4 catalog is refused by name; a new catalog has the presets table.

Through lightwell-json: import, list, apply, undo, capture, create, export, re-import and delete produce the asserted records, events and stacks, and applied pixels equal the equivalent edit.set-* stack.
Duplicate names conflict, unknown or non-patch settings are refused, and an import that maps nothing stores nothing.

steps: Unit-test the catalog library in the editor.
Run a JSON CLI parity test through lightwell-json.
expected_results: Library, capture and parity tests pass.

tasks.description: Render the Presets section in the desktop: grouped library, apply, create form, import, delete, palette entries and event refresh.
extra_context: Generated from the presets control; the view layer holds no core types and the file is read on a worker.

context_links.label: Develop workspace
context_links.relevance: Panel layout, layering rules and verification.

acceptance_criteria: Clicking a preset commits one entry through edit.apply-preset and refreshes through the narrowest completion path.
Create captures only the checked groups; import reports mapped, unsupported and refused counts with a copyable report; delete removes the row; another client's preset appears after its event.
cargo xtask check-repository passes the app layering rules.

steps: Unit-test the presets view model and message handling.
expected_results: App tests pass, including the new presets tests.

extra_context: Background-only launches; the smoke scenario imports a fixture preset through the API and applies it from the section.
acceptance_criteria: A presets smoke scenario passes with correlated state, logs and frames showing the section, the partial badge and the applied photograph.
verify --tier quick and rendered pass; docs describe current behaviour only.

expected_results: Passing scenario with inspected captures and passing verification tiers.
